g.text: Identifying the spring and damper in the tested combined corner
Same physical plant: pair k = 23.6952 N/mm, c = 48 N·s/m; S = 2 kg; 50 N; 90°; sanding drag μ = 0.3.
Calibration corner 8 remains fixed. Only the inverse’s identified k/c and derived coefficients change.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Worst recorded margin improves from 0.0100 N to 0.0470 N across these three paired seeds.
All six force/packing records pass. Scope: three paired seeds at one heavy combined corner; the nominal 3,500-case design stays fixed.
Evidence: native simulations, 400,001 samples per full recording. “Known actual” k/c is a specified model identification condition.
